description: This file defines the RoutingResults class in the Slim framework, which encapsulates the results of routing a request, including route status, identified route, method, URI, and route arguments. It provides methods to access these properties and the allowed HTTP methods for a given route.

classes.name: RoutingResults
classes.description: Represents the outcome of routing a request, including route status, identifier, method, URI, arguments, and associated dispatcher information.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the dispatcher associated with the routing result.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used in the request.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI associated with the routing result.

methods.name: getRouteStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the route (not found, found, method not allowed).

methods.name: getRouteIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the matched route, if any.

methods.name: getRouteArguments
methods.description: Returns the array of route arguments, decoded if specified.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Retrieves allowed HTTP methods for the current route from the dispatcher.
